DialUp.notes: Read from the installed 2.6.1 binary. The generator multiplies a rising counter by a value between 1 and 256 taken from the rate setting and takes a parity bit of the product, giving a square wave of ±5V. A random step is added to the rate every few hundred samples and the running total is clamped to ±1, so the pitch drifts between triggers. Two one-pole filters sit on the output at 2*pi*100 and 2*pi*10000 radians per second; the corner frequencies those imply are not themselves constants in the binary and are left out of the lines.

Swarm.notes: Read from the installed 2.6.1 binary. The clock period is clamp(82.5 - 13.5*x, 15, 150) milliseconds in the fast position and clamp(325 - 150*x, 150, 500) in the slow one, where x runs -5 to 5 from the two speed knobs and the TIME CV.
